topic: induction cooktop: a fast-alternating current in a copper coil makes a changing magnetic field that drives eddy currents in the pot base, whose resistance turns them into heat; why glass/aluminum pots fail, the magnetic base fix, the ring-shaped hot spot problem and the aluminum-core multi-layer base fix

story_beats.state: straight wire with current dots, sky-blue field rings, compass needle turns
the same wire curls into a flat spiral; rings merge and concentrate through the center
current and field arrows flip back and forth; eddy loop in the pot base; base turns grey -> orange
glass pot: no eddy loop, stays grey; aluminum pot: fast faint loop, almost no heat color
dark iron-grey magnetic plate attaches under the aluminum base; base heats and water boils
top-down heat map: red ring above the coil turns, cooler center and edge
the earlier rejected aluminum plate returns and slides between stainless layers; heat map spreads to an even orange
finished multi-layer pot boils evenly; real hand snaps a fridge magnet onto the pot base

final_info.line: 인덕션 냄비 바닥이 여러 겹인 이유죠. / 바닥에 자석이 착 붙으면, 인덕션용입니다.

visual_direction.layout_reference: config/higgsfield-typecast.json layout v5 (mandatory global headline/caption proportions)
visual_direction.viewer_follows: the heat color of the pot base: grey when it fails, a red ring when only the coil-shaped zone heats, even orange when fixed
style_frames: basics stage: sky-blue field rings around a straight wire and the turned compass needle
main cutaway: field loops pass up through the pot base, cyan eddy loop and orange heat in the base
top-down heat map: red ring hot zone with cooler center and edge

sound_design: soft room tone, water starting to boil, low electric hum when the coil appears, small tick for the compass, rising pulse for the fast-alternating current, warm low tone as the base heats, a hollow short tone for the failing pots, a heavy 'clack' when the magnetic plate attaches, one interlocking low hit when the aluminum slides in, a crisp magnet snap at the end; Piljae remains dominant
guards: heat is produced inside the pot base metal; never show the glass plate or the coil glowing red; do not claim the glass stays cold
field loops are closed, pass through the coil center and up through the pot base; arrowheads flip together with the current direction
eddy currents flow as loops in the plane of the pot base, concentric with the coil; never in the pot walls or water
glass pot: no eddy current at all; aluminum pot: current flows but almost no heat at normal cooktop frequency
the magnetic layer is what lets the base heat; the aluminum layer only spreads heat; never show the aluminum core heating by itself
ring-shaped heat is an illustrative concept; the heat map is relative color, no temperatures
no kHz, temperature, power or brand figures on screen or in narration beyond '1초에 수만 번'
do not say every induction pot must be multi-layer; cast iron single-layer pots also work (not shown)
magnet test claim stops at 'if it sticks well, it works on induction'
use mandatory shared layout v5: headline block center y=260, max two lines, 87% width; caption block center y=1306, 64px, 74% width; no background panel, x=540 centered
clarity before texture: only the parts listed in blender.groups; one main cutaway view keeps the same orientation
measure final Piljae narration before committing shot times; if it runs long, ask whether to trim the script or lengthen the video; never speed up or cut speech
